nodes.label: RCR-002 Alpha Hardware and Browser Test Protocol
First Operational Slice
nodes.rationale: receive to create device identity to print label to scan to view authorized device to reconcile. Camera scanning and offline mutation are deliberately excluded from the first slice to keep the tested surface narrow.

nodes.label: Keyboard-Wedge Scanner Primary Path
nodes.rationale: The Alpha path uses a keyboard-wedge scanner handled as exact text with a visible focused field, deliberately avoiding dependence on a camera or a public CDN decoder.

nodes.label: Scanner Test Suite S-01..S-10
nodes.rationale: Pass requires exact matching, controlled focus behavior, safe unknown/unauthorized responses and no stock mutation from scan-only actions; cases cover terminators, control characters, rapid repeats, disconnection and unauthorized scope.

nodes.label: Safe Label Field Allowlist
nodes.rationale: A test label may carry only the permanent human device code, Code128, opaque QR, approved short model text and a template/version marker. Customer data, passcodes, full IMEI, purchase cost, diagnosis and repair issue are excluded so a physical label cannot leak sensitive data.

nodes.label: Label and Printer Test Suite P-01..P-10
nodes.rationale: Physical readability is required; a successful PDF or HTTP response alone is not a pass. Reprint and print-failure cases must not create a second device identity.

nodes.label: Browser and Recovery Test Suite B-01..B-08
nodes.rationale: Refresh, network interruption, back/forward navigation, keyboard-only operation and session expiry must never produce duplicate devices, duplicate stock mutation, false success claims or data leakage.

nodes.label: End-to-End Witness Procedure
nodes.rationale: A single witnessed run records core aggregate quantity before and after, confirms exactly one Device identity and one receipt assignment, proves scan-only navigation does not change stock, and confirms an idempotent retry.

nodes.label: Stop and Rollback Triggers
nodes.rationale: Cohort expansion halts on wrong device/location resolution, duplicate identity or stock post, non-decoding codes, sensitive data on a label, unauthorized disclosure, uncertain state after network failure, an unguarded non-pilot mutation path, or failure to reconcile source quantity with tracked count.
